title: As a child he sensed the tube TV turning on from another room

tellings.quote: I would always know when the TV was on because when my dad would

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, hired him to communicate with aliens, says that as a child he could always tell when the old tube television was switched on, even from another room of the family home. He tells it as an early sign of the unusual sensitivity he believes later made him useful for that work.
